what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Mauritania in Angola: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5402 Mauritanian asylum seekers in Angola, 19.0% of all asylum seekers from Mauritania.
Refugees from Mauritania, a separate group, live mostly in Senegal, Mali, France and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Mauritania in these years: over the government, with AQIM, in 2010.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Mauritania.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2006 at 18 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 5415, at the end of 2014.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Angola.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Angola only.
